skill_name: Explain why it is important to create a diverse workforce.
workflow: It is important to create a diverse workforce because diversity fosters creativity, innovation, and growth. A diverse team brings together different perspectives and ideas, leading to increased creativity and problem-solving skills. It also helps to create a more inclusive and supportive work environment in which all employees feel welcomed and respected.
